why: Each figure has two crosses, one white circle and one black circle. In options 1, 2, 4 and 5 the two crosses are on a diagonal (corner to opposite corner); these figures are the same picture turned by 90 degrees each time. In option 3 the two crosses are side by side in the top row. So option 3 is different.
trick: For 2x2 symbol boxes, check if the same symbols always sit on a diagonal.
note: The black dot in option 5 is printed grey in the scan; it is drawn grey here.
